tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page background: the sky between islands. Every page sits on void.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the gate console, HUD bar.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, hovered tiles, a panel inside a panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and heavy manga panel borders, on void, surface and surface-raised (14:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata, on void, surface and surface-raised (6.2:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Manga panel frames and active borders (3px). Same value as ink by design: panels are drawn, not shaded.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and grid rules only (about 2:1). Never the only edge of a control or anything that carries meaning.

tokens.name: line-hair
tokens.usage: The line language: crosshairs, route lines, orbit rings, intro frame, leader lines, thin frames (1px). Decorative; anything that carries meaning uses ink or an accent.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The brand lime. The TV signal, primary buttons, live/REC dots, island D. Use as a fill with on-accent text. As text, use only on night grounds (use signal-text instead).

tokens.name: hazard
tokens.usage: Hazard yellow. Warning stripes, the jump flash, island A (Works). A fill with on-accent text.

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: Hot magenta. Stickers, manga SFX, island B (About). A fill with on-accent text (5.9:1).

tokens.name: tube
tokens.usage: CRT cyan. Scanlines, links in HUD, island C (Story). A fill with on-accent text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on signal, hazard, pop and tube fills (5.9:1 to 16.7:1).

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and links on void, surface and surface-raised (5.9:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and the signal-lost state, on void and surface. Always paired with a word (ERROR / NO SIGNAL).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid with a 3px offset. 11:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: screentone
tokens.usage: Halftone dot colour for manga screentone fills and image placeholders. Decorative only.

tokens.name: island-a
tokens.usage: District accent for island A (working title: Works).

tokens.name: island-b
tokens.usage: District accent for island B (working title: About).

tokens.name: island-c
tokens.usage: District accent for island C (working title: Story / Lab).

tokens.name: island-d
tokens.usage: District accent for island D (working title: Board / Contact).

families.jp: "Dela Gothic One", "Zen Kaku Gothic New", sans-serif
families.body: "Zen Kaku Gothic New", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per page: the island name on arrival, the gate title.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Panel titles, work titles in the featured slot.

styles.name: sfx
styles.usage: Manga sound effects and katakana labels. Decorative, rotated, never body copy.

styles.name: kana
styles.usage: Small katakana sub-labels under display headings.

styles.name: caption-jp
styles.usage: Quiet Japanese/Chinese captions, often vertical (writing-mode: vertical-rl). The grown-up counterweight to the SFX.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: I make things that glow in the dark.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs on the About island.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy (Chinese, Japanese and English).

styles.name: hud
styles.usage: HUD bar, buttons, stickers. Uppercase Latin.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, sticker padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding (mobile), page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, grid gaps between tiles.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections on island pages.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room, the gap around a featured work.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Panels, tiles, buttons. The system is square: manga panels have corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Stickers and inputs only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: HUD chips and status dots.

tokens.name: stroke-panel
tokens.usage: Manga panel frames, buttons, island outlines.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Grid rules, dividers, scanline edges.

tokens.name: slant
tokens.usage: skewX for buttons, the HUD tab and section index plates. The street-pop lean.

tokens.name: tilt
tokens.usage: Rotation for stickers and SFX. Alternate with 3deg so a row never looks stamped.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Hard manga offset on hovered or featured panels, buttons and tiles. No blur, ever.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: CRT glow behind signal elements on night only: the live dot, the gate title.

tokens.name: z-hud
tokens.usage: The HUD bar.

tokens.name: z-jump
tokens.usage: The island-jump overlay (speed lines and flash).
